TextBlock.Text: Identify the approaching aircraft, protect the sealift transit, then withdraw both fighters.
A Tu-142 is searching the shipping corridor under MiG-23MLD fighter cover. Algol is crossing the exposed sector.
WIDOW 1: two YF-23 B40 20s fighters. An E-2C provides early warning. Yorktown escorts Algol.

Classify the patrol aircraft and lead fighter as hostile. A destroyed contact also counts. Radar use is authorized; weapons start TIGHT. Protect Algol and the Hawkeye until Algol reaches the checkpoint and at least 18 minutes have passed. Then bring both fighters to HANDOFF at 26,000 feet.

Win with both contacts resolved, the transit complete, both fighters at HANDOFF and no incoming weapons. Losing either fighter, Algol, the Hawkeye or neutral shipping fails the mission. Preserving Yorktown earns a bonus.

Your assigned aircraft start airborne with finite fuel and loaded weapons. Fighter sections start line abreast, one nautical mile apart; strike pairs use Vic. Give orders to the leader to control the section. Detach a wingman before assigning a separate task.

September 2025. A fictional Russian expeditionary force threatens shipping in the Gulf of Aden. The four missions are standalone scenarios. Older ships and aircraft remain in service in this alternate history. Requires only Sea Power and this mod.
